method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories grounded in institutional continuity plus temporally gated development, training and competition-system evidence.
evidence_rules: Ecuador's pre-1955 Guayaquil tennis history anchors tradition only; the 1967 federation and current National Tennis Centre/CEJ/JTI structures are gated from their actual years.

India's pre-1955 club/championship/federation history anchors tradition and organised competition context; elite player results in the history narrative are not converted directly into country ratings.
AITA's 2026 HPC, ACE 2032, coaching and junior-pipeline commitments represent programme capacity, not realised outcomes.
Modern programme and infrastructure evidence is never backcast.
Missing historical structural data lowers confidence rather than being treated as zero.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
